buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) SCOPE OF WORK 1.0 The party/agency shall deploy experienced specialist engineer in the relevant field of Boiler Pressur e Parts, Ducts, Hanger & Supports, Fuel system, Lining & insulation, Field Engineer Service expert for Boiler Tuning & to address the recurring operation and maintenance issues. Criteria for Expert: Mini mum Executive Cadre of 5 years’ experience. Supervisor / Technician should be minimum 10 years o f service and above in the relevant field of trouble shooting 2.0 The following consultancy service shall extend to address the issues at NNTPS-NLCIL: 2.1 Pressure Parts: 2.1.1 To study and suggest corrective action to prevent tube erosion in aspect of operatio n / Maintenance to mitigate tube erosion in Pressure parts (Zone: RH-1, Economizer, S pout panel). 2.1.2 Failure Analysis of Damaged Tubes and submission of recommendation for corrective action. 2.1.3 To give feasibility report for introduction of Standby line with control Valve in SH Spr ay control station. 2.1.4 To Study and give recommendation to minimize the boiler vibration at various elevation 2.1.5 To study and give recommendation to minimize the ash leakage via LRSB sleeves. 2.1.6 To study the cause of repeated BTL failure in Corner-2 & Corner-3 @56m near Backs tays elevation and give recommended solution. 2.2 Fuel Firing: 2.2.1 To address the issue in flame catching during cold start up with ignitor.

2.2.2 To address the issue of frequent damage of refractory, Cooling air pipes in Lignite bu rner. 2.3 Duct: 2.3.1 To study gas distribution pattern and give recommendation to mitigate Ash accumul ation at ESP inlet duct and combustion air duct. 2.3.2 To address the Burner Secondary air duct sagging issue with appropriate support. 2.3.3 To address the issues, pertain to refractory detachment from Flue gas resuction duct at 45 m elevation from mother plate. In General, any other issues related to boiler operation and maintenance for which M/s BHEL Shall ex tend their support. 3.0 BHEL-Experts shall submit the report to address the issues for future course of action. ***** 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SPECIAL CONDITIONS Part-I 1.0 The servicing shall be done only during general shift hrs i.e from 9:30 to 18:30 hrs. Inclusive of lunc h hour break. This will be treated as one-man day for the purpose of billing, for Sunday & public holi days as observed by NLCIL/ NNTPS site will be treated as non-working days however if worked, the p ayment shall be done as per the specific line item mentioned in BOQ. 2.0 Payment for journey fare will be done as per BOQ line item on per person per trip basis. 3.0 Required manpower for assistance, spares and consumables shall be provided by NLCIL. 4.0 NOC/PF will not be applicable for this contract as the agency will be deploying their permanent serv ice engineer for the job. 5.0 The Contractor expert who is engaged in site should maintain daily attendance register and daily w ork log during the working periods. 6.0 The contractor should submit a detailed report on work performed with any suitable recommendati ons to NLCIL shall be furnished. Part-II 1.0 SUPERVISOR CHARGES – PENALTY CLAUSE Not Applicable 2.0 Tools & tackles, lifting machines & Safety appliances that are used for the work or by the workmen / Supervisor / Engineer / Technician should posses ISI mark and valid test certificate from the compe tent authority. 3.0 The Contractor should observe all safety rules and regulations in force and ensure that all necessa ry safety precautions are followed up strictly for the safety of workmen / Supervisor / Engineer / Tech nician engaged in the work. 4.0 The Contractor should engage adequate man power having appropriate skills with the approval of the NLCIL officials to carryout and complete the works. Any extra time / over time engagement of th e man power shall be the contractor’s responsibility. 5.0 RATE REVISION (NOT APPLICABLE). 6.0 CONTRACT WORKMEN DEATH RELIEF FUND (CWDF) 6.1 An amount equivalent to 0.2% (zero point two percent) of gross value of every bill payable ( before statutory, non statutory deductions) shall be deducted towards “Contract Workmen De ath Relief Fund” (CWDF) from the contractors for the works carried out by the contractor. No p

rovision has been made in the estimate towards the above deduction. 6.2 Based on the modified DRF scheme, monthly contributions to the death relief fund of Contra ct Workmen / Supervisors shall be deducted by the Contractor Employers concerned @ Rs.25/ - from every contract workman / Supervisors engaged by Contractor Employer for the works in NLCIL from their salary /wages payable. In order to facilitate this, necessary deduction will be made from the bills of the Contractor employers based on Form - D (Attendance Register) & F orm -B (Wage Register) Equal monthly contribution to the fund @ Rs.25/- per contract workma n / Supervisors will be made by the Principal Employer NLCIL i.e. the Concerned Unit Head / U nit Accounts Centre. 7.0 CONTRACT WORKMAN AGE The contractor shall not engage workmen beyond 60 years and the Contractor s hall also produce the required age proof for the workmen engaged by him, while applying for entry permit for first time. 8.0 ESI & EPF The Contractor Employers shall be required to undertake the responsibility of re mitting the contribution/ subscription etc., of the contract workmen / Supervisor / Engineer / Technician engaged by them towards EPF, ESI etc., (as applicable). 9.0 SAFETY Personal protective equipments (PPE) ie like Helmet, Safety shoe, Goggles etc b y to be provided by the contractor and it is in the scope of the contractor. 10.0 PRICE REDUCTION CLAUSE Not Applicable. 11.0 GUARANTEE FOR WARRANTY Not Applicable 12.0 CONTRACT PERFORMANCE GUARANTEE Not Applicable 13.0 PERIOD OF CONTRACT 13.1 The contract period: 15 months from the date of service start date or 31/03/2028 whichever i s earlier. Note: Lead days of 3 days are provided to the Service Provider for necessary mobilization for offerin g service. Thus the service start date will commence from minimum 3 days after contract gen eration date. 13.2 MOBILISATION PERIOD & INTIMATION An advance intimation of 15 days will be given to enable the service engineer to take up the o verhauling job and the Contractor has to mobilize manpower accordingly. 14.0 PAYMENT TERMS Payment will be released through running bill based on the actual work on certifi cation of NNTPS Engineer In-charge. Payment will be released within 45 days fro m the acceptance of Invoice. Final bill will be made after finalization of contract. 15.0 GST (Goods and Service Tax) Contractor has to furnish the GST Registration number with relevant docume ntary evidence.

Contractor has to comply with the GST Act/ Rules. 16.0 NLCIL reserves the right to short close / extend the contract due to special circumstances. 17.0 The General Conditions clauses 12.0 & 35.19 are not applicable. **** . 3.
